title: Approximation: Decimal Places and Significant Figures
seo_title: Approximation – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Round numbers to a given number of decimal places and significant figures; estimate answers to calculations. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on approximation: significant figures of large and small numbers, decimal places and estimating calculations. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Count significant figures from the first non-zero digit
body_html:
How to think about it

  • To round to n significant figures, start counting at the first non-zero digit.
  • For large numbers keep zeros to hold the places: 386,500 to 2 s.f. is 390,000.
  • Estimate by rounding each number to 1 significant figure.

Examples

Example

0.007 285 to 2 s.f.

First s.f. is 7

Answer: 0.0073

Example

Estimate 41.2 × 0.48

40 × 0.5

Answer: 20

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting leading zeros0.0073 has 2 significant figures.
Dropping place-holding zeros390,000, not 39.
Rounding each stepRound only at the end.

faq.a: 3 (the last zero only holds a place).
